description: Price history as candles (open, high, low, close, volume) for any market. Intervals from 1 second to 1 month. Default: 1h candles for the last 24h. since/until accept Relative ("30m", "6h", "24h", "7d"), a date ("2026-10-01"), a date-time ("2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"), "now", or Unix ms.

coin.description: Market name, any case: "BTC", "eth", "HYPE", "kPEPE", or a HIP-3 market such as "xyz:TSLA".

interval.description: Candle size (default "1h"). "1s" only covers about the last 30 minutes.

name: hydromancer_price_history
title: Price candles (OHLCV)
